name: Optimized Source-Spectral Invariant Laws
statement: $\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}$ is invariant under coordinate permutations and reflections, is nonincreasing under nonempty pc-minors, and satisfies $\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}(C\times D)=\max\{\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}(C),\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}(D)\}$. Among classes admitting a union-closed orientation, $\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}<1$ exactly characterizes convex realizability. Either $\eta_0=0$ or $\eta_\infty=0$ implies $\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}=0$.
proof: On the union-closed-orientation domain, the identity $\delta_{\mathrm{sp}}=\tau^2$ transfers cube symmetry, minor, product, and realizability laws from $\tau$. Outside that domain both the orientation minimum and the corresponding factor obstruction have value infinity. A zero one-sided indicator makes respectively $\alpha=\infty$ or $\beta=0$.
